package outbox

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Relay struct {
	Outbox         repository.Outbox
	Publisher      domain.EventPublisher
	Clock          Clock
	WorkerID       string
	BatchSize      int
	LockTTL        time.Duration
	PublishTimeout time.Duration
	RetryBase      time.Duration
	RetryMax       time.Duration
}

func (relay Relay) ProcessBatch(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	if relay.Outbox == nil || relay.Publisher == nil || relay.Clock == nil || strings.TrimSpace(relay.WorkerID) == "" ||
		relay.BatchSize < 1 || relay.LockTTL <= 0 || relay.PublishTimeout <= 0 ||
		relay.LockTTL <= time.Duration(relay.BatchSize)*relay.PublishTimeout ||
		relay.RetryBase <= 0 || relay.RetryMax < relay.RetryBase {
		return 0, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := relay.Clock.Now().UTC()
	events, err := relay.Outbox.Claim(ctx, repository.OutboxClaim{
		WorkerID: relay.WorkerID, Limit: relay.BatchSize, Now: now, LockedUntil: now.Add(relay.LockTTL),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var failures []error
	for _, event := range events {
		publishContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, relay.PublishTimeout)
		publishErr := relay.Publisher.Publish(publishContext, event)
		cancel()
		if publishErr != nil {
			retryAt := relay.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(relay.retryDelay(event.Attempts))
			if markErr := relay.Outbox.MarkFailed(ctx, event.EventID, relay.WorkerID, publishErr.Error(), retryAt); markErr != nil {
				failures = append(failures, errors.Join(publishErr, markErr))
			} else {
				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("publish %s: %w", event.EventID, publishErr))
			}
			continue
		}
		if err := relay.Outbox.MarkPublished(ctx, event.EventID, relay.WorkerID, relay.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			failures = append(failures, err)
		}
	}
	return len(events), errors.Join(failures...)
}

func (relay Relay) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	delay := relay.RetryBase
	for current := 1; current < attempt && delay < relay.RetryMax; current++ {
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > relay.RetryMax {
		return relay.RetryMax
	}
	return delay
}
